designationHistory.indexText: Alamosa National Wildlife Refuge was set aside in 1962 under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act as a haven for migratory birds.

authority.citation: Migratory Bird Conservation Act of 1929 (16 U.S.C. 715d); Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approval

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Alamosa National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Federal Register, Mar. 15, 2011 (doc. 2011-5924): San Luis Valley NWR Complex CCP notice ("Alamosa NWR, authorized in 1962 ... under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act")
USFWS, Alamosa and Monte Vista NWRs general information brochure (2019): "Alamosa NWR was established in 1962"

USFWS, Alamosa-Monte Vista National Wildlife Refuge Complex Colorado: Comprehensive Conservation Plan (ServCat 1373): "Alamosa NWR was approved for acquisition on June 27, 1962, by the Migratory Bird Conservation [Commission]"

review.note: MBCC approved the refuge June 27, 1962 (2003 CCP); FWS planning notice and brochure also give 1962. About Us page says 1963, likely the first land acquisition.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Alamosa National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1963 to provide food, cover, and breeding habitat for migratory birds and resident wildlife.

historySource: Refuge About Us pages, fws.gov (draft, pending review)
